Discography
Home » Statistical Information » Discography
  • Original
  • Collaboration
  • Compilation
  • Playlist


An overview of Bruce Springsteen's (semi-) official releases (Original, see also Wikipedia), including Compilation albums that contain a Springsteen song and Collaborations, where Springsteen appears on an other artsist's album. However we do not aim to list all the releases out there in the world, for that there are other sites already available (eg. SpringsteenLyrics). The ones we have listed have only new, or newly recorded songs, or unique live performances.
For more details on the tracks of these releases please visit our Studio Guide to Bruce Springsteen.
